description: What the JavaScript of every Oxyn window may reach, kept to what the front calls. Windows are labelled workspace-<uuid> by Rust (src/backend/windows.rs, ADR-0043); the pattern covers them with exactly these three permissions, and none creates a window or a webview: a window opens only through Oxyn's own bounded command. every permission here widens what an XSS in the webview could do (docs/SECURITY.md, entry surface 5; docs/adr/0029-interface-tauri-shadcn.md). core:window:allow-start-dragging: pressing a data-tauri-drag-region element moves the window, which has no title bar on macOS (titleBarStyle Overlay). core:window:allow-internal-toggle-maximize: double-clicking that region maximizes or restores the window, as a native title bar would. dialog:allow-open: the connection screen picks a database file through the native open dialog. Nothing else: Tauri 2 checks neither Oxyn's own commands (src/main.rs, local origin, no app permissions/ manifest) nor Channel data fetches against this list, and the core plugin's default permission set would add path, event, window, webview, app, image, resources, menu and tray commands the front never calls.
